summary: Gangs fight over named turfs they can see on a chat map. A turf can only be taken while its owners are online, after a short wake-up; the bar starts when attackers outnumber everyone inside and living guards count as defenders. Every rule is one sentence shown where it applies. Actively held turf pays the bank and levels the gang; dormant gangs earn nothing. The gang is told anywhere when a turf is hit and what happened while away. Foundations land first; guards become per-turf squads; roles wait for H13. Gangs+ parity addendum (2026-09-30): every GP-01..45 row is HAVE or DELIVERED by W5 (parity: gang core, after the W2 gate, beside W3) and W6 (fights module, WorldGuard flag, the 'Gangs+ parity reached' gate, beside W4), with Gangland's own verbs (safehouse, rally, ranking, upgrade, profile, notice, fight propose/enlist/drop); one additive api bump for the branch; 0.14.0 merges after the later of the W4 and W6 gates (D23).

player_promise: Open /glw map and you always know who owns what around you, and what you can attack.
Every rule that stops you is one sentence, shown at the moment it applies, and it is the same sentence everywhere.
A turf can only be taken while its owners are around to defend it, after a short wake-up; guards hold it when you are outnumbered.
Your gang is told, anywhere, when a turf is hit, and what happened while you were away.
Finding or starting a gang takes one command, and a fresh gang works out of the box.

Everything a gang plugin does, your gang does here too: levels you earn on turf and pay to claim, safehouses that cannot break a fight, gang and ally chat, friendly fire you control, rankings, profiles and arena fights with a bet.

pillars.name: One rule per fight
pillars.why: Today an owned turf is capturable only after the whole owner gang has been offline 10+ minutes and nobody is inside (CaptureService.isCapturable L112-127, tickIdle); fights never happen with owners present, unclaimed capture has two stacked bars, and one rival alt inside blocks every start (L209).

features.name: Capture window
features.player_view: You can attack a turf while its owners are online, after a short wake-up; it stays attackable until ten minutes after the last owner leaves. Shielded turfs are underlined on the map and say why on entry; Rats are camping Docks - shield ends in 1:40 reaches the owner on login.
features.mechanics: Capture_Window: OWNERS_ONLINE (default, D1) flips isCapturable's last line to now - owner.getLastMemberOnlineAt() <= graceMs (Post_Logoff_Protection_Minutes moves to turf_rules.yml as Shield_After_Logout_Minutes 10 with a legacy read); OWNERS_OFFLINE (today, the small-server switch) one line away; ALWAYS not shipped. Wake_Up_Shield_Seconds 120 after the owner gang goes from zero to one online member (tracked in memory). Qualifying members: GangPresenceListener/heartbeat refresh lastMemberOnlineAt only for members whose Member.getGangJoinDateLong() age >= Window_Min_Member_Age_Hours 24; a gang younger than that counts every member; gang join sets the join date like create and invite-accept do. A running contest continues through logouts (already true: nothing re-checks isCapturable). Inactivity_Release_Days 4 is the anti-hoarding rule.

features.name: Plurality start, presence rule, no stalls
features.player_view: The bar starts when your gang has more people inside than the owners and their allies and more than any other single gang; attackers count after 15 seconds inside, alive (You count in 12 s); defenders count at once; a bar never fills faster than 60 s; a fight that goes nowhere for 10 minutes ends.
features.mechanics: Replace 'exactly one challenger and zero defenders' with the strict plurality above (closes the alt blocker TF-48 and camping-as-immunity); entry timestamp in TurfLocationTracker; classify skips young attacker entries only; reset on death, respawn, teleport; an entry is re-stamped when its relation to the turf owner changed since the last tick (ally-abandon exploit); Min_Capture_Seconds 60 clamps the net rate; Max_Contest_Minutes 10 fails the contest with NEW TurfCaptureFailedEvent.Reason.STALLED (defenders hold, normal cooldown).

features.name: One bar for every capture

layers.description: One area marker per turf filled with Color.getBukkitColor(), contested turfs outlined; dynmap as a softdepend; dynmap-api provided in gangland-turf/pom.xml (W3-W owns the pom + repository, reflection facade as fallback); dynmap types only inside GT/map/web/** created from a type-free factory behind a plugin-present check so ReflectionGuard never skips TurfModuleConfig; all calls on the main thread; Web.Show_Owner true, Web.Show_Income false, guards never shown.

render_rules: Fixed north-up: rows north to south, columns west to east; Width and Height odd (41 x 7 default so header + grid + legend fill the unfocused chat; Height 9 is the documented admin option); the viewer sits in the centre cell; Cell_Blocks 16.

One glyph width class only: - (no turf), # (unclaimed), + (you), gang letters A-Z except I, digits 2-9 after 25 visible gangs. No ., !, lowercase or bold: they are 2-4 px wide against 6 px (bold adds 1 px) and break columns.

Glyph carries identity: first letter of the resolved display name (colour codes stripped), collision -> next letter of the name, then the first free letter; allocated viewer's gang first, then allies, then ascending gang id, so walking one cell never hands your own letter to a newer neighbour.

Colour carries relation to the viewer, always: own GREEN, ally AQUA, rival RED, owned-as-seen-by-gangless YELLOW, unclaimed # GRAY, no turf - DARK_GRAY, you + WHITE. Colour never carries identity (16 Color names, 14 codes) and never carries state (green/red/gold collapse under deuteranopia, dark red approaches dark grey under protanopia).

State carries by width-neutral formatting: italic = under attack; underline = shielded for the viewer (owners offline, waking up, just captured, over your cap: every CaptureEligibility reason maps to one style and one word). Verified in the GUI-scale checklist.

Majority rule: a cell shows the turf covering >= 50% of it, else -; a turf that wins no cell is drawn in the cell holding its centre so small turfs never vanish; turfs never overlap (TurfManager.findConflict); adjacent turfs of one gang join into one run and the hover names each.

Hover per merged run carries turf-level facts only: turf name; owner or Unclaimed; state (Quiet / Under attack by Rats, 62%); the CaptureEligibility reason (attackable / shielded: no Rats online / shielded: over your cap); minutes-since-online only on the viewer's own gang; pays per interval or dormant; Your guards: N in reserve for the owner gang only. No cell coordinates or coverage. The + cell's hover carries the turf under you, your coordinates and facing.
Click runs /glw turf info <id> (read-only). Admins see /glw turf tp <id> in the hover text, never as a click.

Header (Map - Turfs 3/4 - north is up - + you; empty window: No turf in view - nearest Docks 320m NE) and both legend lines measure <= 300 px by the vanilla width table (TerritoryRaster.pixelWidth, tested); legend line 1 packs gang entries while they fit (names truncated to 8, full name in the letter hover) and ends with +N more (hover lists them, click = /glw map legend); line 2 is fixed: # unclaimed  - none  italic attacked  underlined shielded. Bedrock/Geyser (no hover) and colour-blind players lose nothing.
Adjacent cells with identical glyph, colour, style and hover merge into one component (typically under 60 per frame).

Auto-map re-sends when the set of turfs in the window changes or the viewer enters/leaves a turf, at most every Auto_Min_Interval_Seconds (5), and when the world's turf version bumped and the raster hash changed; driven by a 1 Hz BeanLifecycle task, never PlayerMoveEvent (TurfLocationTracker javadoc forbids it); default off; prefs in memory, cleared on quit.
Floodgate players (UUID prefix 00000000-0000-0000, no Floodgate dependency) receive the text form because the Bedrock font is proportional.
Owners-only facts (guards in reserve) and other gangs' online times never reach a rival's hover or the web layer.

decisions.question: When can an owned turf be attacked? Today: only after the whole owner gang has been offline 10+ minutes and nobody is inside (CaptureService.isCapturable L112-127, tickIdle).

options.label: OWNERS_ONLINE with wake-up and qualifying members
options.detail: Attackable while a qualifying owner-gang member (joined >= Window_Min_Member_Age_Hours 24 ago; every member of a gang younger than that) is online, after a Wake_Up_Shield_Seconds 120 shield when the first one logs in; shielded 10 minutes after the last logout; a running capture continues through logouts; the start needs a strict plurality of attackers over owners+allies and over any other single gang. One line in isCapturable flips > to <= plus three comparisons.

options.label: ALWAYS with offline slowdown
options.detail: Attackable after the cooldown; twice as slow when all owners are offline. Makes offline raiding the dominant strategy; recorded, not shipped.

options.label: OWNERS_OFFLINE (today) plus alerts and digest
options.detail: Keeps the inverted loop: gangs wait for each other to log off. Shipped as the one-line small-server switch.

options.label: Scheduled war windows
options.detail: A server-set time of day; a good later knob, not a first rule.

decisions.why: One sentence explains it, fights happen with owners present, guards have a visible job, the wake-up shield stops login snipes, the join-age rule stops an infiltrator opening the shield, and Inactivity_Release_Days 4 plus the activity gate handle gangs that never log in. C ships as the other Capture_Window value.

decisions.question: How is snowballing bounded?

options.label: Cap by level with a ceiling, XP only for active turfs
options.detail: cap = min(Turf_Cap_Ceiling 6, Turf_Cap_Base 2 + 1 per level); XP is paid only when a qualifying owner was online within Income_Idle_Hours 24, so a dormant or alt gang earns none; shown as Turfs 3/4.

options.label: Cap by active members
options.detail: cap = min(6, 1 + members seen in the last 7 days / 2) via OfflinePlayer.getLastPlayed() at payout time (no column); level becomes pride only.

options.label: Upkeep per turf
options.detail: A running cost from the bank; a second economy rule.

options.label: No cap
options.detail: One-member gangs hoard unlimited turf.

decisions.why: One visible number, gang level has a consumer (GR-19 closes), and the activity gate removes the passive-farm loop that made B attractive; Level already carries a formula curve so XP is small. B is one getLastPlayed() loop away if playtests still see alt gangs lifting their cap.

decisions.question: Snap new turf boundaries to chunks so the map has no partial cells?

options.label: On for new turfs only
options.detail: Turf.Snap_To_Chunks: true; existing turfs untouched; findConflict re-run on the snapped region.

options.label: Off
options.detail: Edges show as majority cells.

options.label: On plus migrate existing
